issues.detail: Threads TH1 (13 messages), TH2 (14 messages), and TH3 (12 messages) are below the expected minimum of 16 messages per thread. They also fall short of the blueprint's target_messages_range.
Several mandatory artifacts are missing from the artifact_refs in their respective threads: TH2 is missing T2 and T3; TH3 is missing T4 and T12; TH4 is missing T5, T8, and T11.
The forbidden term 'scenario' (or 'scenarios') is explicitly used in the text of messages M41, M45, M46, M47, M51, and M52.
